Coeliac card

私はセリアック病です。
グルテンを含む小麦・大麦・ライ麦を、少量でも食べることができません。
普通のしょうゆ（小麦入り）、小麦粉、パン粉、麦（むぎ）を使わないでください。
同じ揚げ油、調理器具、まな板、包丁、トングなどからの混入も避けてください。
「グルテンフリー」と表示されたしょうゆ／たまりしょうゆだけを使ってください。
安全に対応できない場合は、無理に作らず教えてください。
ありがとうございます。
I have coeliac disease. I cannot eat even a small amount of wheat, barley or rye containing gluten. Please do not use regular soy sauce containing wheat, flour, breadcrumbs or barley. Cross-contact from shared fryer oil, utensils, cutting boards, knives or tongs must also be avoided. Please use only soy sauce or tamari labelled gluten-free. If it cannot be prepared safely, please tell me rather than trying to make it. Thank you.

Food risk framework in this build

Tier A · strongestOfficial source states an all-gluten-free menu and a controlled/no-gluten kitchen environment. Still disclose coeliac disease.
Tier A− · strongOfficial venue information presents dishes as gluten-free, but the evidence captured for v0.1 is not enough to claim zero cross-contact risk.
Tier B · confirm firstGluten-free accommodation is offered, but cross-contact controls must be confirmed with staff before ordering.
Reality check: “Gluten-free” in Japan does not automatically mean coeliac-safe. Regular soy sauce often contains wheat, and shared fryer oil or utensils can invalidate an otherwise gluten-free ingredient list.

Verified shortlist stored offline

Opening hours are a snapshot, not a guarantee. v0.1 stores the information checked on 13 Aug 2026 so it remains available offline. Reconfirm close to travel if internet is available.

Build diagnostics

What v0.1 proves

The real application shell can carry an embedded Kyoto raster, geolocation, route overlays, POI search, practical layers and coeliac support while remaining a single local HTML file. This is intentionally not yet the final 25 km-radius Kyoto data package or turn-by-turn navigation.

Map provenance

Embedded raster derived from the Wikimedia Commons “Kyoto Japan street map” artwork by Kirill Shrayber (CC0), calibrated to the “Map Kyoto 2” geographic extent by Justin Kunimune (CC0). The latter is based on OpenStreetMap data. Where OpenStreetMap-derived data applies, © OpenStreetMap contributors. No map server is contacted at runtime.

Coeliac disease · please show staff

If staff are uncertain about ingredients or cross-contact, choose another dish or venue.
